doc.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006

title: Hot Five and Hot Seven tribute at Jazz at Lincoln Center
summary: Rowe admires the Hot Five and Seven; Jacobs announces Marsalis's tribute with cheap tickets for children.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: When I listen to some of the Hot Five and Hot Seven, it sounds so new to me for that time. It’s just unbelievable the exuberance that came out of his instrument. Indescribable.

Do you know that Wynton Marsalis is going to be doing three days of a salute to the Hot Five and the Hot Seven at Jazz at Lincoln Center in September of this year? And we succeeded in getting him to have his department market some of the tickets that can be sold for ten dollars to school children so that it isn’t prohibitive for them to come into the Jazz at Lincoln Center, which is quite an expensive ticket.
